questions.stem: What is meant by the 'compensation point' in plants?

options.text: The point at which a plant stops growing due to lack of minerals
The light intensity at which the rate of photosynthesis equals the rate of respiration
The temperature at which enzymes in leaves are denatured
The point at which all stomata are fully closed

questions.explanation: The compensation point is the light intensity at which the rate of photosynthesis exactly equals the rate of respiration. At this point, there is no net gas exchange because the CO2 produced by respiration is used up by photosynthesis, and the O2 produced by photosynthesis is used up by respiration.
